spots.name: Thunder Basin National Grassland: US Forest Service 942 Rd. & Coal Bank Draw area
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 110 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L3017467.

spots.name: Black Butte

spots.name: Porcupine Reservoir
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
